id: THEORY1: predictions of the lower-body sufficiency propositions (offline replay, ESTCMP2 pelvis-IMU logs of the final controller: quiet + px/py 50 N, seeds 1111-1113)

propositions.P1: the resultant non-foot wrench is determined by the 6 base rows and 12 leg rows; upper-body joint torques do not enter
propositions.C1: with the disturbance parameterised at the pelvis, adding the 17 upper-body rows (with their torques) leaves the least-squares estimate unchanged
propositions.P3: upper-body torque errors enter every estimator that uses upper-body joint rows containing the unknown (whole-body momentum observer; whole-body rows with the disturbance attributed to the torso), in proportion to the error

injection: constant per-joint bias on the 17 upper-body torque estimates (waist 3 + arms 14), b_j ~ N(0, s^2) with a fixed seed per run, s in {0, 0.5, 1, 2} N m; plus Coulomb-friction mismatch s * sign(qdot_j). Leg torques untouched
estimators: IMU-SME (split: base + leg rows, leg torques), WB-pelvis (all rows, all torques, disturbance at the pelvis), WB-torso (all rows, all torques, disturbance at the torso), tuned MOB (all 29 torques, ESTCMP2 settings)
metric: RMS horizontal error against the applied force in double support 3.0-3.5 s (px/py, 6 runs) and quiet-stance RMS (3 runs)

predictions.T1 invariance: IMU-SME output identical for all s (max |difference| < 1e-6 N)
predictions.T2 inertness: WB-pelvis identical to IMU-SME for all s (max |difference| < 1e-6 N)
predictions.T3 sensitivity: WB-torso and MOB error at s = 2 N m exceeds their own s = 0 error by more than 2 N (push RMS or quiet RMS), and increases monotonically in s
